title: Saudi-led coalition launches wide-ranging operation against Houthis
english: A Saudi-led coalition has initiated a broad military campaign against Houthi forces in Yemen. During this operation, they successfully struck over 130 military targets held by the group. Additionally, the coalition is actively providing continuous aerial assistance to support the Yemeni government's ongoing efforts.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የምትመራው ጥምረት በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ጥምረቱ በቡድኑ ቁጥጥር ስር የነበሩ ከ130 በላይ ወታደራዊ ኢላማዎችን ማውደሙን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ጥምረቱ በየመን መንግስት ኃይሎች ላይ እየተደረገ ላለው ውጊያ ተከታታይ የሆነ የአየር ድጋፍ እየሰጠ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummoota Sa'udii Arabaatiin durfamuun, waraanni Yaman keessatti argamu hidhattoota Huthota irratti duula bal'aa banuu isaa beeksiseera. Duula kanaanis, iddoowwan harka Huthotaa turan keessaa bakkeewwan waraanaa 130 ol ta'an barbadeessuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, gamtichi kun humnoota mootummaa Yaman gargaaruuf gorsa qilleensaa yeroo hundaa taasisaa jira.

title: Trump announces deal with Putin to release Russian diesel
english: President Donald Trump has secured an agreement with Vladimir Putin to increase the supply of Russian diesel to the global market to help lower rising fuel costs. Under this deal, Russia will provide several shipments of diesel starting immediately, which the US Treasury has authorized through a temporary license. This initiative is part of the administration's broader strategy to reduce energy prices for Americans ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ ከሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር የሩሲያ ዲዝል ወደ ገበያ እንዲገባ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት ሩሲያ በደረጃ የሚለቀቅ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ዲዝል ታቀርባለች፤ የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤትም ይህንን ነዳጅ ለመግባት የሚያስችል ጊዜያዊ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ይህ እርምጃ ከመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ በፊት በአሜሪካ የሚስተዋለውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ግሽበት ለመቆጣጠር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Traamp dhiheessii diizilaa idil-addunyaatti dabaluun gatii boba'aa hir'isuuf Pirezedaantii Raashiyaa Vilaadimiir Puutin waliin walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Walii galtee kanaan, Raashiyaan diizilaa baay'ina isaa guddaa ta'e gabaatti gadhiisuuf kan itti gaafatamtu yoo ta'u, mootummaan Ameerikaas diizilli kun gabaa isaanii keessa akka seenuuf hayyama yeroo kenneera. Tarkaanfiin kun filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuun dura gatii boba'aa Ameerikaa keessatti ol ka'e hir'isuuf kan yaadame dha.

title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
english: The US administration has announced new, broad sanctions against the International Criminal Court, aiming to restrict its financial operations and protect American sovereignty. While the US claims the court acts like a rogue institution by targeting its citizens, the ICC and several world leaders have condemned the move as an attack on international justice. Despite the sanctions, many nations have reaffirmed their commitment to the court, and a temporary grace period has been granted to allow for potential negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአሜሪካን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር በሚል የዓለም አቀፉን የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) በገንዘብ ነክ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ እገዳ ጥሏል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ ውሳኔ በዓለም አቀፍ የሕግ የበላይነት ላይ የተቃጣ ጥቃት ነው ሲል ሲተች፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና ሌሎች አጋር ሀገራት በውሳኔው ቅር መሰኘታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም አሜሪካ በድርጅቱ ላይ ያሳለፈችው ማዕቀብ ውጤታማ እንዳይሆን የተወሰነ ጊዜ የሰጠች ቢሆንም፣ ይህ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ የፍትህ ስርዓቱን በእጅጉ እንደሚጎዳ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa seeraa fi mirga biyyattii kabachiisuuf jechuun, mana murtii yakkaa addunyaa (ICC) irratti tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa fudhateera. Mana murtichi tarkaanfii kana seera addunyaa irratti haleellaa kan raawwate jechuun balaaleffateera; biyyoonni addunyaa hedduunis murticha akka hin degarre ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa yeroo murtaa’e tokko kennus, tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbaticha hojii isaa akka dhaabu gochuuf kan karoorfame ta’uu beekameera.

title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
english: Former UN human rights commissioner and South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The committee honored her long-standing dedication to international law and her efforts to prosecute war crimes, genocide, and crimes against humanity. By winning this prestigious award, she joins other notable South African recipients such as Nelson Mandela and Desmond Tutu.
amharic: የቀድሞው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብት ኮሚሽነር እና የደቡብ አፍሪካዊቷ ዳኛ ናቪ ፒላይ የ2026 የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማት አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። የኖቤል ኮሚቴው ለሽልማት ያበቃቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን ለማስከበር እና የጦር ወንጀሎችን፣ የዘር ማጥፋትን እና የሰው ልጆች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ ለብዙ ዓመታት ላደረጉት ጥረት ነው። በዚህም ፒላይ እንደ ኔልሰን ማንዴላ እና ዴዝሞንድ ቱቱ ካሉ ታዋቂ የደቡብ አፍሪካ አሸናፊዎች ተርታ ተሰልፈዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun duraanii mirga namoomaa UN fi abbaan seeraa biyyaa Afrikaa Kibbaa Navi Pillay badhaasa Nobel Peace Prize kan bara 2026 injifataniiru. Komiteen Nobel kun badhaasa kana kan kenneef, seera idil-addunyaa kabajchiisuu fi yakka waraanaa, yakka sanyii balleessuu fi yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatamu qorachuuf hojii cimaa hojjechaa turaniifidha. Badhaasa kana argachuun isaanii, akkuma Nelson Mandela fi Desmond Tutu, namoota Afrikaa Kibbaa badhaasa kana argatan keessaa akka tokko isaan taasiseera.

title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
english: US Vice-President JD Vance has expressed skepticism regarding the Pentagon’s proposal to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the soldier convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. While Vance acknowledged the severity of the crimes, he stated that he would not watch the broadcast if it takes place. The plan to livestream the military execution has faced significant backlash from politicians on both sides, who argue that turning such events into public spectacles is unethical and inappropriate.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በፎርት ሁድ የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ፈጻሚ በሆነው ኒዳል ሀሰን ላይ ሊወሰድ የታቀደውን የመተኮስ የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማሳየት የተወሰነውን ውሳኔ ተጠራጠሩ። ምንም እንኳን የጥቃቱን አሳሳቢነት ቢገልጹም፣ ስርጭቱ ቢፈጸም እንኳን እንደማይመለከቱት አስታውቀዋል። ይህንን የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማስተላለፍ የታቀደው እቅድ ከሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ አባላት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ ለህዝብ መዝናኛነት መቅረቡ ስነ-ምግባር የጎደለው እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Itti aanaan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, mootummaan naannoo waraanaa Nidal Hasan jedhamu kan bara 2009 Fort Hooditti namoota ajjeese irratti murteeffamee ture, dhukaasaan ajjeesuu fi sana immoo tamsaasa kallattiin (livestream) darbusuu isaatti shakkii qaban ibsan. Vance yakkichi cimaa ta'uu isaa hubatanii, tamsaasi sun yoo ta'e illee ofii isaanii akka hin ilaalle dubbataniiru. Sagantaan ajjechaa kana tamsaasuuf karoorfame kun mormii cimaa paartilee siyaasaa lamaan biraayyuu kan itti dhufe yoo ta'u, ajjechaan akkasii akka bashannanaatti tamsaasuun safuu fi seeraan kan hin deeggaramne ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
english: The prominent Russian tech firm Yandex is experiencing major operational issues following Ukrainian drone strikes on two of its key data centers. These facilities, which are essential for the company's search engine, AI, and smart home services, sustained significant damage during the back-to-back attacks. Ukrainian officials stated the strikes were a retaliatory measure intended to disrupt resources supporting Russia's ongoing military campaign.
amharic: የሩሲያ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ የሆነው ያንዴክስ በዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃቶች በሁለት ዋና ዋና የመረጃ ማዕከላት ላይ ጉዳት በመድረሱ የአገልግሎት መስተጓጎል አጋጥሞታል። እነዚህ ማዕከላት የኩባንያውን የፍለጋ ሞተር፣ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት እና ዘመናዊ የቤት መገልገያ መሳሪያዎችን ለማስኬድ እጅግ ወሳኝ ናቸው። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በሩሲያ ለሚደርስባቸው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት እና የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማዳከም እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teeknoolojii guddichi Raashiyaa Yaandeeks, buufataaleen odeeffannoo isaa lama weerara xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drone) Yukreeniin miidhamuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoo tajaajilaa mudateera. Buufataaleen kunneen sirna barbaaddoo (search engine), 'artificial intelligence' fi meeshaalee mana keessaa to’achuuf baay'ee barbaachisoo dha. Mootummaan Yukreen akka jedhetti, weerarri kun haleellaa Raashiyaan isaanirra geessisaa turteef deebii kennuufi dandeettii waraana Raashiyaa dadhabsiisuuf kan raawwatame dha.

title: European states, Canada, Japan and UN back ICC against US sanctions
english: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC), aiming to block its operations and prevent the prosecution of American citizens. In response, several key US allies, including European nations, Canada, and Japan, have joined the United Nations in condemning the move. These countries and the ICC itself view the sanctions as a dangerous attack on the global rule of law and have pledged to protect the court’s independence.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) ላይ ማዕቀብ የጣለች ሲሆን፣ ይህም የፍርድ ቤቱን ስራ ለማስተጓጎል እና የአሜሪካ ዜጎች በችሎት እንዳይጠየቁ ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። ለዚህ ድርጊት ምላሽ ለመስጠት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት፣ ካናዳ፣ ጃፓን እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ውሳኔውን አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት እና ፍርድ ቤቱ ራሱ፣ ማዕቀቡ በአለም አቀፍ የህግ የበላይነት ላይ የተቃጣ ጥቃት መሆኑን በመግለጽ የፍርድ ቤቱን ነጻነት ለመጠበቅ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Mana Maree Yakka Adunyaa (ICC) irratti sagantaa adabbiiwwan dinagdee kan kute yoo ta'u, kunis hojii mana marichaa gufachiisuufi lammiilee Ameerikaa himannaa irraa ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Gocha kana ilaalchisee, biyyoonni michoota Ameerikaa ta'an kan akka Awurooppaa, Kaanaadaa, Jaappaaniifi Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii mormii cimaa agarsiisaniiru. Biyyoonni kunniinifi mana marichi ofiinuu, adabbiin kun seera adunyaa irratti haleellaa cimaa akka ta'e ibsuun, bilisummaa mana marichaa eeguuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Tsunami warnings across Latin America after 7.7 magnitude earthquake hits
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck southern Panama, causing significant tremors and structural damage to buildings in the area. In response, authorities have issued tsunami warnings for several nations across Central and South America, including Colombia, Ecuador, and Chile. Residents have evacuated affected areas as emergency officials monitor the coastline for potential waves.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፓናማ የደረሰው 7.7 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በበርካታ ህንጻዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ይህንን ተከትሎ ኮሎምቢያን፣ ኢኳዶርን እና ቺሊን ጨምሮ በበርካታ የላቲን አሜሪካ ሀገራት ላይ የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ተላልፏል። ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናትም የባህር ወለል እንቅስቃሴን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Sokkoo lafaa cimaa hamma 7.7 ta'een Kibba Paanaamaatti erga mudatee booda, miidhaan garagaraa bulchiinsa sana keessatti dhaqqabeera. Haala kanaan walqabatee biyyoota Ameerikaa Laatiin kan akka Kolombiyaa, Ekuwoador fi Chiilii dabalatee akeekkachiisni suunaamii labsameera. Ummanni naannichaa iddoo ofiirraa akka fagaatan ta'uun, mootummoonnis sochiin galaanaa maal akka fakkaatu hordofaa jiru.

title: Injured Orangutan rescued from Indonesia wildfires
english: A young orangutan was saved after being caught in wildfires on the Indonesian island of Borneo. The animal sustained burn injuries to its limbs and is currently recovering at a veterinary facility. Many other orangutans have also been rescued as the spreading fires continue to destroy their natural forest habitat.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ቦርንዮ ደሴት በተከሰተ የደን ቃጠሎ የተጎዳች ወጣት ኦራንጉታን መዳን ችላለች። እንስሳቱ በእጆቿ እና በእግሮቿ ላይ የቃጠሎ ጉዳት ስለደረሰባት በአሁኑ ወቅት የእንስሳት ህክምና ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ህክምና እየተደረገላት ትገኛለች። የደን ቃጠሎው የበርካታ ኦራንጉታኖችን መኖሪያ በማውደሙ ብዙዎቹ ለህልፈት ከመዳረጋቸው በፊት ታድገዋል።
oromo: Orangutanin tokko qarqara bosonaa Indonesia, Borneo irratti ibidda ka'een miidhamee fayyuu danda'eera. Bineensichi harkaafi miilla isaa irratti miidhaan gubaa irra ga'ee, amansi hospitaala bineensotaatti wal'aanamaa jira. Ibiddichi iddoo jireenya bineensotaa kanaa mancaasuu hordofee, orangutanonni hedduun biroon lubbuun baraaramaa jiru.

title: Katie Zacharia ‘offered’ position as White House press secretary
english: President Donald Trump has reportedly offered the role of White House press secretary to conservative commentator Katie Zacharia. Zacharia, who currently serves as a senior communications adviser for Trump Media and Technology Group, previously worked at the Department of Homeland Security. She will fill the vacancy left by Karoline Leavitt, who resigned from the position this past August.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዋይት ሃውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊነት ቦታውን ለወግ አጥባቂዋ አስተያየት ሰጪ ኬቲ ዘካሪያ እንደሰጡ ተዘግቧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የትራምፕ ሚዲያ እና ቴክኖሎጂ ግሩፕ ከፍተኛ የግንኙነት አማካሪ ሆነው በማገልገል ላይ ያሉት ዘካሪያ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም በአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መምሪያ ሰርተዋል። እሳቸውም ካሮሊን ሌቪት ባለፈው ነሐሴ ወር ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ክፍት የነበረውን ቦታ ይረከባሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp bakka bu'aa sagalee mootummaa (press secretary) Mana Maree Adii akka taatuuf gorsituu fi yaada kennituu konservativii Keetii Zaakaariyaaf dhiheessuun isaanii himameera. Keetiin yeroo ammaa gorsituu quunnamtii ol'aantuu kan taate Traamp Meediyaa fi Teeknooloojii Gireep keessatti yoo ta'u, kanaan dura Ministeera Nageenya Biyyaalessaa keessatti hojjetteerti. Isheenis bakka Kaaroliin Leevit ji'a Hagayyaa darbe gadi dhiifte bu'uun itti gaafatamummaa kana ni fudhatti.

title: ‘Barbaric’: US lawmakers condemn plan to livestream Nidal Hasan’s execution
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing strong backlash from both Republican and Democratic lawmakers over his plan to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan. Hasan, a former Army officer responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, is scheduled to be executed by a firing squad in December. Critics argue that broadcasting the execution is barbaric, inappropriate, and un-American, insisting that the focus should remain on justice rather than creating a public spectacle.
amharic: የአሜሪካው መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ፣ የኒዳል ሃሳንን የሞት ፍርድ በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማስተላለፍ ያቀዱት እቅድ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። በ2009 የፎርት ሁድ ጥቃትን የፈጸመው የቀድሞው ወታደራዊ ዶክተር ኒዳል ሃሳን፣ በሚቀጥለው ታህሳስ ወር በጥይት እንዲገደል ተወስኗል። ተቺዎች ይህን ድርጊት አሰቃቂ እና ለአሜሪካ እሴቶች የማይመጥን በማለት በመተቸት፣ ትኩረቱ የህግ ፍትህ ላይ እንጂ በይፋዊ መዝናኛ ላይ መሆን እንደሌለበት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa Pheet Heegseet, ajjeechaa Nidal Haasan jedhamuu kan gara fuulduraatti raawwatamu viidiyoo qajeelaan (livestream) akka darbu karoorsuun isaanii mormii cimaa paartilee lameen irraa isaan mudateera. Nidal Haasan, kan bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Fort Hood irratti namoota ajjeese, ji'a Muddeetti rasaasaan akka ajjeefamu murtaa'eera. Mormitoonni gocha kana akka fokkataa fi kan seera Ameerikaa waliin hin deemneetti kan ilaalan yoo ta'u, xiyyeeffannaan mirga namoota miidhamanii kabajuu irratti malee, akka agarsiisaa uummataatti ilaalchisuu irratti ta'uu hin qabu jedhaniiru.

title: Two killed in Saudi strike on Sanaa airport, Houthi media says
english: Saudi military airstrikes hit the airport in Sanaa, Yemen, resulting in two deaths. This attack occurred just one day after Houthi forces launched their own strikes on a Saudi airport that killed three people. Additionally, Yemeni authorities reported that the Saudi bombardment caused several fires, including the destruction of a local factory.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈፀመው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረው ሶስት ሰዎችን ከገደሉ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ነው። በተጨማሪም የሳውዲ ጥቃቶች በከተማዋ የተለያዩ ቦታዎች ላይ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትለው ፋብሪካን ጨምሮ በርካታ ንብረቶች እንዲወድሙ ማድረጉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Saudii buufata xiyyaaraa Sanaa, kan magaalaa guddoo Yaman irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni lama lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko dura gareen Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa Saudii irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii erga du'anii booda. Kana malees, haleellaa Saudiin qaqqabeen magaala sana keessatti ibidda ka'ee qabeenyaa fi warshaan tokko barbadaa'uu gabaasameera.

title: Trump says Russia to immediately supply diesel fuel ahead of midterms
english: Following a successful meeting with President Putin, Donald Trump announced that Russia will begin shipping millions of tonnes of diesel to help stabilize the global market. The US Treasury has authorized this supply through a temporary permit to help combat record-high fuel costs. This initiative aims to address rising diesel prices just before the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሩሲያው አቻቸው ከቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ ሩሲያ ለዓለም ገበያ የናፍጣ ነዳጅ እንደምትልክ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት ይህ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እንዲከናወን ጊዜያዊ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምርጫ ወቅት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ለማረጋጋት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp pirezidaant Putiin waliin marii erga godhaniin booda, Raashiyaan gabaa addunyaaf boba'aa diiseelii akka ergitu beeksisaniiru. Waajjirri Qabeenyaa Ameerikaa boba'aan kun gabaa addunyaa akka gahu hayyama yeroo kenneera. Tarkaanfiin kunis yeroo filannoo dura gatii diiseelii hir'isuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Israeli settlers and troops target olive harvesters, wedding convoy in West Bank attacks
english: Israeli settlers and military forces conducted a series of violent attacks against Palestinians across the West Bank on Friday. Armed settlers targeted olive farmers, a family in their vehicle, and a wedding procession, resulting in injuries and property damage. Additionally, Israeli troops raided the town of Idhna, where they fired tear gas at local residents.
amharic: ባለፈው አርብ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች በተለያዩ የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢዎች በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። የታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎች የወይራ አጫጆችን፣ አንድ ቤተሰብን እና የሰርግ ሰልፍን በማጥቃታቸው ጉዳት እና የንብረት ውድመት ደርሷል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የኢድና ከተማን በመውረር በነዋሪዎች ላይ አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata darbe weerartoonni Israa’el fi waraanni isaanii naannoo Daangaa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa gaggeessaniiru. Weerartoonni hidhatan qonnaan bulaa zaytuunaa, maatii tokko fi namoota cidha irratti argaman haleelanii miidhaa geessisaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa’el magaalatti Idhna weeraruudhaan gaazii imimmaan fiduu lammiilee irratti gadi dhiisaniiru.

title: UN chief condemns US sanctions on ICC as international backlash grows
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has strongly criticized the U.S. government for imposing sanctions on the International Criminal Court. He warned that these actions undermine global efforts to pursue justice and jeopardize the independence of the judicial body. While many international allies have joined the UN in condemning these measures, Israeli leadership has welcomed the move.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በአሜሪካ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ የተጣለውን ማዕቀብ አጥብቀው ተቃውመዋል። የወሰዱት እርምጃ አለም አቀፍ ፍትህን ለማስፈን የሚደረገውን ጥረት የሚያደናቅፍ እና የፍርድ ቤቱን ነፃነት የሚፈታተን ነው ሲሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በርካታ የአሜሪካ አጋር ሀገራት ውሳኔውን ቢቃወሙትም፣ የእስራኤል መንግስት ግን እርምጃውን በመደገፍ አድንቋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii Antonio Guterres tarkaanfii mootummaan Ameerikaa Mana Maree Yakka Adunyaa irratti fudhate cimsee balaaleffateera. Tarkaanfiin kun haqa adunyaalessaa mirkaneessuuf carraaqqii taasifamu kan miidhuu fi walaba ta'uu mana maree kanaa kan shakki keessa galchu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni gurguddoon hedduun tarkaanfichaan mormanis, mootummaan Israa'el garuu murtii kana akka waan gaariitti simateera.

title: Trump promises 'big news' on diesel as prices near record highs
english: President Trump recently announced that he expects diesel prices to drop significantly soon, though he did not provide specific details on how this will be achieved. Fuel costs have surged by 70 percent following the conflict involving Iran and Israel, causing concern ahead of the upcoming elections. The President remains optimistic that the situation will improve shortly and suggested that the ongoing conflict will also reach a conclusion soon.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ የናፍጣ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀንስ አስታውቀዋል፣ ነገር ግን ይህ እንዴት እንደሚሳካ ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም። በኢራን እና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለው ግጭት ከተቀሰቀሰ ወዲህ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በ70 በመቶ ጨምሯል፣ ይህም ከመጪው ምርጫ በፊት ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ሁኔታው በቅርቡ እንደሚሻሻል እና ግጭቱም በቅርቡ እንደሚቆም እምነት አላቸው።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp gatiin disilii yeroo dhiyootti baay'ee akka gadi bu'u ibsaniiru, garuu kana akkamitti akka raawwatan ibsa bal'aa hin kennine. Waraana Iiraan fi Israa'el gidduutti ka'een booda gatiin boba'aa dhibbeentaa 70 dabalee jira, kunis filannoo dhufuun dura yaaddoo uumee jira. Pirezedaantichi haalli kun yeroo dhiyootti fooyya'uu akka danda'u fi waraannis dafee xumuramuuf akka jiru abdii qabu.

title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
english: Alonzo Lunsford, a survivor of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, agrees that the shooter deserves to be executed by a firing squad rather than other methods. However, he expressed strong reservations about the Pentagon's plan to livestream the execution to the general public. While Lunsford plans to witness the event in person to confront the shooter, he believes the broadcast could be inappropriate and potentially harmful if viewed as entertainment.
amharic: የ2009 የፎርት ሁድ ተኩስ ጥቃት የተረፉት አሎንዞ ለንስፎርድ፣ አጥቂው በሌሎች ዘዴዎች ሳይሆን በጥይት ተደብድቦ እንዲገደል መደገፋቸውን ገለጹ። ሆኖም፣ ፔንታጎን ግድያውን በኢንተርኔት በቀጥታ ለማስተላለፍ ያቀደውን ዕቅድ ተችተዋል። ለንስፎርድ ራሳቸው በአካል በመገኘት አጥቂውን መጋፈጥ ቢፈልጉም፣ ግድያው ለሕዝብ መታየቱ ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ እና ለመዝናኛነት ሊወሰድ እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Alonzo Lunsford, namni bara 2009 haleellaa Fort Hood irraa oole, ajjeechaan namicha haleellaa raawwate sanaa ajaja dhukaasaa (firing squad) ta'uu isaa ni deggera. Haa ta'u malee, Pentagon-ni ajjeechaa kana intarneetiin akka waltajjiitti gadi lakkisuuf karoorfate yaada isaa hin deggeru. Lunsford ofii isaa achi argamee ija nama ajjeese sanaa keessa ilaaluu kan barbaadu ta'us, sagantaan kun akka bashannanaatti ilaalamee miidhaa geessisuu akka danda'u yaaddoo qaba.

title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
english: The French government has pledged to hire 3,000 additional substitute teachers to address widespread student protests calling for better educational resources. This move comes after weeks of demonstrations, which have frequently turned violent and resulted in thousands of arrests among young people. While the education minister hopes this will stabilize schools, many protesters remain unsatisfied, as further demonstrations are already being planned.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ መንግስት የተሻለ የትምህርት ግብዓት እንዲሟላ በመጠየቅ ላይ ላሉ ተማሪዎች ምላሽ ለመስጠት 3,000 ተጨማሪ ተለዋጭ መምህራንን ለመቅጠር ቃል ገብቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ለሳምንታት በዘለቀው እና ሁከት በተቀላቀለበት የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ወጣቶች ከታሰሩ በኋላ ነው። የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ ይህ እርምጃ በትምህርት ቤቶች የሚታየውን ክፍተት እንደሚሞላ ተስፋ ቢደረግም፣ ተቃውሞው እንደሚቀጥልና ለቀጣይ ሳምንትም ተጨማሪ ሰልፎች መታቀዳቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay barattoota barnoota fooyya'e gaafachaa jiraniif deebii kennuuf jecha barsiisota bakka bu'oota ta'an 3,000 ramaduuf waadaa galeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga torbanoota hedduuf hiriirri mormii gochaan hammeenyaa kan itti uumamee fi dargaggoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman erga qabamaniin booda. Ministeerri barnootaa tarkaanfiin kun rakkoo hir'ina barsiisotaa furuuf gumaacha akka qabu kan ibse ta'us, hiriirtonni ammayyuu guututti kan hin quufne ta'uu fi torban dhufuufis hiriirri biraa qophaa'aa jiraachuun beekameera.

title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
english: Ethiopia has formally notified the UN Security Council that it intends to defend its sovereignty following claims that Eritrean forces invaded the Tigray region. The Ethiopian government accuses its neighbor of launching an incursion, while Eritrea denies these allegations and blames Ethiopia for the escalating tension. This situation follows a breakdown in diplomatic relations between the two countries, raising concerns about the potential for a renewed regional conflict.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የኤርትራ ኃይሎች ወደ ትግራይ ክልል በመግባት ወረራ ፈጽመዋል በሚል ለተባበሩት መንግሥታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት አቤቱታዋን አቅርባለች። የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥት ሉዓላዊነቱን ለማስከበር እንደሚከላከል ሲገልጽ፣ ኤርትራ ግን የቀረበባትን ክስ አስተባብላ ጦርነቱን የጀመረው የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥት ነው ስትል ትከሳለች። በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት መቋረጡ እና እየተካሄደ ያለው የድንበር ውጥረት በክልሉ ሌላ ጦርነት ሊቀሰቀስ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan humnoonni Eertiraa gara naannoo Tigraayitti seenuun humnaan akka seeran jedhee Mootummoota Gamtoomaniif gabaasa dhiyeessiteetti. Mootummaan Itoophiyaa biyyattiin of ittisuuf mirga akka qabdu beeksisus, Eertiraan himata kana haaluun Itoophiyaan waraana kana akka qabsiiste himatti. Hariiroon dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii addaan cituun fi wal-dhabdeen daangaa irratti uumame kun naannichatti waraanni biraa akka hin kaane yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Ethiopia and Eritrea accuse one another of launching war
english: Ethiopia and Eritrea have officially traded accusations of launching military aggression against one another, causing a significant breakdown in their diplomatic relations. Ethiopia claims that Eritrean forces have invaded its northern Tigray region, while Eritrea alleges that Ethiopia has been pursuing an unprovoked war to capture its port access. These escalating tensions have led to international concern as both nations deny each other's claims of military collusion and territorial infringement.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ እና ኤርትራ እርስ በርስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደሰነዘሩ በመወነጃጀላቸው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት በእጅጉ ተበላሽቷል። ኢትዮጵያ የኤርትራ ኃይሎች ወደ ሰሜናዊው የትግራይ ክልል ዘልቀው በመግባት ወረራ እንደፈጸሙ ስትገልጽ፣ ኤርትራ በበኩሏ ኢትዮጵያ ወደ ቀይ ባህር መውጫ ለማግኘት በማሰብ ከሶስት ዓመታት በላይ ያለ ምንም ቅስቀሳ ጦርነት እያካሄደች እንደሆነ ትከሳለች። እነዚህ እያደጉ የመጡ ውጥረቶች ሁለቱ አገራት እርስ በርስ ለሚደረጉ የወታደራዊ ትብብር እና የድንበር ጥሰት ክሶች እውቅና ባለመስጠታቸው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa fi Eertiraan wal-abdatuun weerara waraanaa wal irratti banuu isaanii himachuun hariiroon dippiloomaasii isaanii sadarkaa gadi bu'aa irra ga'eera. Itoophiyaan waraanni Eertiraa gara naannoo Tigraayitti darbuun weerara gaggeessaa jiraachuu yoo himattu, Eertiraan immoo Itoophiyaan buufata doonii ishee to’achuuf jecha waraana kallattii malee banuuf yaalaa jirti jechuun himatti. Wal-dhabdeen kun daran hammaachaa waan jiruuf, lamaanuu himata wal-qabachuu fi daangaa cabsuu irratti dhiyeessan waakkachuun isaanii sodaa nagaa naannichaa hir'iseera.

title: Bangladesh’s mango diplomacy with India has reached its limits
english: Bangladesh has used cultural exchanges, such as gifting mangoes and textiles, to maintain diplomatic ties with India following significant political changes in Dhaka. While these soft power gestures successfully prevented a complete breakdown in relations, they are insufficient to resolve deep-seated political and security issues. Future stability between the two nations now requires moving beyond symbolic efforts to engage in difficult, substantive negotiations.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በዳካ በተከሰተው የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ተከትሎ ከህንድ ጋር የነበራትን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለማስቀጠል እንደ ማንጎ እና የጨርቃ ጨርቅ ያሉ ባህላዊ ስጦታዎችን ትጠቀም ነበር። እነዚህ የለስላሳ ዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ግንኙነቱ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዳይቋረጥ የረዱ ቢሆንም፣ የሁለቱን ሀገራት መሰረታዊ የፖለቲካ እና የደህንነት ችግሮች ለመፍታት በቂ አልሆኑም። ስለዚህ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር ከምልክታዊ ድርጊቶች ባለፈ አስቸጋሪ በሆኑ የፖለቲካ ድርድሮች ላይ ማተኮር ይገባል።
oromo: Bangladeshiin jijjiirama siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti booda hariiroo Indiyaa wajjin qabdu itti fufsiisuuf akka mangoofi uffata aadaatti fayyadamtee jirti. Gochootni kun hariiroon akka hin citte ittisuuf gargaaranis, rakkoolee siyaasaafi nageenyaa gurguddaa furuuf garuu gahaa hin turre. Kanaafuu, hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf gochoota mallattoo qofa irra darbuun marii siyaasaa cimaa fi bu'a qabeessa ta'e gaggeessuun barbaachisaa dha.

title: Who is Navi Pillay, winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize?
english: South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong dedication to human rights and international justice. Throughout her career, she has bravely prosecuted war crimes, including presiding over the Rwanda tribunal and leading UN investigations into genocide. As a current judge at the International Court of Justice, she remains a prominent figure in the global fight against humanitarian abuses.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካዋ ዳኛ ናቪ ፒላይ ለሰብአዊ መብት እና ለዓለም አቀፍ ፍትህ ላበረከቱት የዕድሜ ልክ አስተዋጽኦ የ2026 የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማትን ተቀዳጅተዋል። በሙያ ዘመናቸው የሩዋንዳውን የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ችሎት በመምራት እና በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የዘር ማጥፋት ምርመራዎችን በመምራት የጦር ወንጀለኞችን ለፍርድ በማቅረብ ይታወቃሉ። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአለም አቀፍ የፍትህ ፍርድ ቤት ዳኛ በመሆን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን ለመከላከል የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa biyya Afrikaa Kibbaa Naavii Piilaay, mirga namoomaa fi haqaa idil-addunyaa kabajsiisuuf guutummaa jireenya isaanii guutuu waan hojjataniif badhaasa Noobeelii nagaa bara 2026 argataniiru. Hojii isaanii keessatti yakka waraanaa fi ajjeechaa sanyii duguugguu irratti gumaacha guddaa kan godhan yoo ta'u, manni murtii Ruwaandaa fi qorannoon tokkummaa mootummootaa irratti qooda fudhataniiru. Yeroo ammaa murtii haqaa idil-addunyaa irratti abbaa seeraa ta'uun, miidhaa namoomaa dhaabsisuuf qabsoo isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Ukraine pushes Russia back in Donetsk as military, civilian casualties soar
english: Ukrainian forces are successfully reclaiming territory in the Donetsk region through a counteroffensive known as Operation Vivaldi. By strategically targeting Russian supply lines and capitalizing on Russian communication errors, Ukraine has pushed back Moscow’s troops from several villages near Lyman. While the operation has forced Russia into a defensive position, the conflict continues to result in significant casualties for both soldiers and civilians.
amharic: የዩክሬን ጦር 'ኦፕሬሽን ቪቫልዲ' በተሰኘው የመልሶ ማጥቃት ዘመቻ በዶኔትስክ ክልል የተያዙ ቦታዎችን መልሶ እየተቆጣጠረ ይገኛል። የዩክሬን ኃይሎች የሩሲያን የጦር መሳርያና ነዳጅ አቅርቦት በማስተጓጎል እና የጠላትን ስልታዊ ግድፈት በመጠቀም ከሊማን አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ በርካታ መንደሮችን ነፃ አውጥተዋል። ይህ ስኬት ሩሲያን ወደ መከላከያነት የገፋት ቢሆንም፣ በሁለቱም ወገኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ የሰው እና የንብረት ጉዳት እየደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni Yukreeni duula 'Opereshinii Viivaaldii' jedhamuun naannoo Dooneetskitti lafa qabamee ture deebisanii to'achaa jiru. Humnoonni Yukreeni dhiyeessii meeshaa waraanaa fi boba'aa Raashiyaa gufachiisuu fi dogoggora odeeffannoo isaanitti fayyadamuun, gandaa fi magaalota Liimaanitti dhihoo jiran hedduu bilisa baasaniiru. Injifannoon kun Raashiyaa ittisa irratti akka xiyyeeffattu kan dirqisiise yoo ta'u, waraanni kun garuu gama lamaanuu miidhaa lubbuu fi qabeenyaa guddaa geessisaa jira.

title: Child flees as Israeli settlers hijack car during pogrom
english: A Palestinian boy was forced to run for safety after Israeli settlers attacked his father and stole their vehicle in Ramallah. This incident was part of a broader wave of violence, with at least 19 similar attacks reported across the occupied West Bank on Friday. These events highlight the escalating tensions and recurring confrontations involving settlers in the region.
amharic: በራማላህ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በአንድ ፍልስጤማዊ አባት ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረው መኪናቸውን በወሰዱበት ወቅት አንድ የፍልስጤም ልጅ ለሕይወቱ ሲል ከቦታው ለመሸሽ ተገዷል። ይህ ክስተት በአርብ ዕለት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ ከተፈጸሙ ቢያንስ 19 የጥቃት ድርጊቶች አንዱ ነው። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Magala Ramallaah keessatti lammiileen Israa'el namoota biyya lafaa kanaa irratti miidhaa erga geessisanii booda, abbaa fi ilma konkolaata isaanii saamaniiru. Ilmi kunis lubbuu isaa oolchuuf bakka sanayyuu baqateera. Gochi kun guyyaa Jimaataa guutuu naannoo 'West Bank' tti haleellaa wal-fakkaataa 19 ol raawwataman keessaa tokko dha. Mudannoon kun miira sodaachisaa fi waldhabiinsa naannichatti hammaataa jiru kan ibsu dha.

title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
english: An immigration enforcement agent shot and wounded a man during an operation in the Bronx, New York, on Thursday. Government officials claim the individual has a significant criminal history, while local leaders have expressed outrage and are demanding the release of body camera footage. Protesters have gathered to condemn the incident, raising serious concerns about how the agency conducts operations within the city.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኒውዮርክ ከተማ ብሮንክስ አካባቢ በተካሄደ ዘመቻ፣ የስደተኞች ጉዳይ አስፈጻሚ ወኪል አንድን ሰው ተኩሶ አቁስሏል። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ግለሰቡ ከባድ የወንጀል ታሪክ እንዳለው ቢገልጹም፣ የአካባቢው መሪዎች ግን በድርጊቱ ከፍተኛ ቁጣቸውን በመግለጽ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስሎች እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል። በአካባቢው የተሰባሰቡ ተቃዋሚዎችም ይህንን ድርጊት በማውገዝ፣ ኤጀንሲው በከተማዋ ውስጥ በሚያደርገው እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ጥያቄ አንስተዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa magaalaa Nuyuurkiitti, bakka Bronx jedhamutti, jilaan gargaartuu hojii godaantotaa nama tokko rasaasaan rukutee mureera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti namichi kun seenaa yakkaa ulfaataa kan qabu yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni naannichaa garuu gocha kana balaaleffachuun vidiyoon kaameraa qaamaa akka ifa ta'u gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni naannichatti walgahanii gocha kana kan morman yoo ta'u, hojiin ejansii kanaa magaalaa keessatti balaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Who is Dov Lando, the Israeli rabbi criticising Zionism?
english: Rabbi Dov Lando, a 96-year-old leader of a major ultra-Orthodox party in Israel’s ruling coalition, has sparked controversy by condemning Zionism as a source of harm to the Jewish people. In a leaked recording, he suggested that Jews might have been safer and better off without a state, arguing that Zionism provoked conflict with Arabs. These comments have created significant political tension ahead of Israel's upcoming elections, where the ultra-Orthodox community's influence remains a critical factor.
amharic: የ96 ዓመቱ ረቢ ዶቭ ላንዶ በእስራኤል ገዢ ጥምረት ውስጥ ያለ ትልቅ የሃይማኖት ቡድን መሪ ሲሆኑ፣ ጽዮናዊነት በአይሁድ ህዝብ ላይ ጥፋትን አምጥቷል በማለት ውዝግብ ፈጥረዋል። በተሰራጨ የድምጽ ቅጂ ላይ አይሁዶች መንግስት ሳይኖራቸው በተሻለ ሁኔታ ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመግለጽ የጽዮናዊነት አስተሳሰብ ከአረቦች ጋር ለተፈጠረው ግጭት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አስተያየት በእስራኤል የሃይማኖተኛ ማህበረሰብ ሚና በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በሚታይበት ወቅት፣ ከመጪው ምርጫ ጋር በተያያዘ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Rabbi Dov Lando, hoogganaa umrii 96 kan ta'an fi garee ultra-Orthodox mootummaa Israa'el keessatti dhiibbaa qabu kan hogganan, yaada 'Zionism' ilmaan Israa'el irratti balaa fide jechuun kanneen biroo irratti mormii kaasan. Sagaleen isaa maxxanfame irratti, Yihuudonni biyya ofii qabaachuu mannaa, mootummaa malee jiraachuu akka danda'an fi Zionism kunis diinummaa Arabaa wajjin akka hammaate dubbataniiru. Yaanni kun filannoo Israa'el kan dhufuuf jiru irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira, keessattuu gaheen hawaasa amantii kun siyaasa biyyattii keessatti bakka guddaa waan qabuuf.

title: Afghanistan’s emerald miners struggle with tools but attract global buyers
english: Miners in Afghanistan’s Panjshir valley are using basic, manual tools to extract high-quality emeralds that are in high demand from international buyers. Despite the harsh working conditions and lack of modern equipment, these gemstones have become a vital economic lifeline for thousands of locals. Recent government-led auctions have generated millions of dollars, helping to boost state revenue in an economy struggling with poverty and sanctions.
amharic: በአፍጋኒስታን ፓንጅሺር ሸለቆ የሚገኙ ማዕድን አውጪዎች ጥራት ያላቸውን ኤመራልድ ድንጋዮች ለመቆፈር አሁንም ድረስ በእጅ የሚሰሩ ቀላል መሳሪያዎችን ይጠቀማሉ። እነዚህ የከበሩ ድንጋዮች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ያላቸው በመሆኑ ለሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዋና የገቢ ምንጭ ሆነዋል። መንግስት በሚያካሂዳቸው ጨረታዎች አማካኝነት በየዓመቱ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ገቢ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በኢኮኖሚ ችግር እና በ ማዕቀብ ውስጥ ለሚገኘው አፍጋኒስታን ትልቅ ድጋፍ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni baay'ee lafa Panjshir, Afganistaan keessa jiran, dhagaa gati-jabeessa 'emeraaldii' jedhamu baasuuf meeshaalee salphaa fi harka qofa fayyadamu. Dhagaan kun qulqullina olaanaa waan qabuuf, gabaa idil-addunyaa irratti barbaadamaa fi bu'uura jireenyaa namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa'amaniif ta'eera. Mootummaan wayita ammaa gabaa kana gurmeessuun mallaqa miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu argachaa jiru; kunis biyyattii koroopshinii fi sagantaa dhiibbaa diinagdee jala jirtuuf gargaarsa guddaa ta'eera.

title: Trump says US will not strike Iran before midterm elections
english: President Donald Trump has officially stated that the United States will not launch any military strikes against Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. This announcement was aimed at easing regional tensions, leading to a noticeable drop in global oil prices. Meanwhile, both nations continue to engage in diplomatic discussions, even as reports of naval incidents in the Strait of Hormuz persist.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ እስከ ህዳር 3 ቀን በሚካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ድረስ በኢራን ላይ ምንም ዓይነት ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደማትሰነዝር አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ በክልሉ የነበረውን ውጥረት በማርገብ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። በሌላ በኩል ሁለቱ ሀገራት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ድርድር እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ የሚከሰቱ የባህር ኃይል እንቅስቃሴዎች ስጋት እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, Ameerikaan hanga filannoo giddu-galeessaa Sadaasa 3tti Iran irratti haleellaa waraanaa akka hin banne beeksisaniiru. Ibsi kun yaaddoo naannichaa hir'isuun gatiin boba'aa akka gad-bu'u godheera. Gama biraatiin, biyyoonni lameen karaa diippilomaasiitiin marii godhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, ta'us naannoo galaana Hormuzitti sochiiwwan waraanaa mudachaa jiranuun sodaan jiraachuun ibsameera.

title: Brazilian Supreme Court judge issues arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro
english: A Brazilian Supreme Court judge has ordered the arrest of Eduardo Bolsonaro, the son of the former president, following his conviction for illegally lobbying the US to interfere in Brazilian judicial matters. Currently living in the United States, Bolsonaro faces a four-year prison sentence, and the court has revoked his passport to prevent him from escaping justice. This legal development occurs just weeks before a high-stakes presidential runoff election, further intensifying the political tension in the country.
amharic: የብራዚል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ዳኛ የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ልጅ የሆኑትን ኤድዋርዶ ቦልሶናሮን በቁጥጥር ስር እንዲውሉ ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። ኤድዋርዶ ቦልሶናሮ በብራዚል የፍርድ ሂደት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ አሜሪካን በመለመን ጥፋተኛ ሆነው በመገኘታቸው የአራት ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩት ኤድዋርዶ፣ ወደ ብራዚል እንዳይገቡ ፓስፖርታቸው ተሰርዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱን የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር እየተካሄደ ባለበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa mana murtii olaanaa Biraazil ilma duraanii pirezidaantii kan ta'an Eduardo Bolsonaro, dhimma seerummaa Biraazil keessatti akka gidduu seenan Amerikaa kadhachuu isaaniitiin erga yakka itti muramee booda akka hidhaman ajajeera. Yeroo ammaa Amerikaa jiraatanis, Bolsonaro hidhaa waggaa afurii kan eeggatu yoo ta'u, mana murtichis biyyatti akka hin deebineef paspoortii isaanii haqee jira. Murtiin kun filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyyattii kan lammaffaa dhiyaatee jiru keessatti, morkii siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti kaka'umsa guddaa uumee jira.

title: From Aden to Sanaa, Yemenis struggle to deal with soaring living costs
english: Yemen is facing a severe economic crisis as ongoing conflict and a divided financial system drive up living costs. Many citizens are struggling to afford basic necessities because salaries are either unpaid or insufficient to cover the rising prices of food and rent. This long-term instability has significantly reduced the quality of life for millions of people across the country.
amharic: የየመን ህዝብ ቀጣይነት ባለው ግጭት እና በተከፋፈለ የፋይናንስ ስርዓት ሳቢያ የኑሮ ውድነት ተግዳሮት እየገጠመው ይገኛል። ደመወዝ ባለመከፈሉ ወይም በቂ ባለመሆኑ በርካታ ዜጎች የምግብ እና የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋን መሸፈን ተስኗቸዋል። ይህ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየው የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ የየመን ነዋሪዎችን የኑሮ ደረጃ ክፉኛ ጎድቷል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni itti fufee fi sirni baankii gargar hiramee jiru gatiin jireenyaa akka olka'u godheera. Hojjettoonni mindaa hin arganne ykn mindaan isaanii gatii nyaataa fi kiree manaaf ga'aa waan hin taaneef, namoonni baay'een jireenya guyyaa guyyaa isaanii jiraachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Rakkoon dinagdee kun waggoota dheeraaf itti fufee waan jiruuf, namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Morning update
english: The IRGC Navy reports it is actively monitoring and policing the Strait of Hormuz, while the U.S. has returned the USS Abraham Lincoln to San Diego following a lengthy deployment. Meanwhile, the Gaza conflict continues with significant civilian casualties and destruction reported. Diplomatic efforts are ongoing, with Russia pledging assistance for peace and the U.S. imposing new sanctions on Iran's oil shipping network.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ የባህር ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቋል፤ የአሜሪካው አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ USS Abraham Lincoln ረጅም ተልእኮውን አጠናቆ ወደ አገሩ ተመልሷል። በሌላ በኩል በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ጦርነት አሁንም ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እየቀጠፈ ይገኛል። ሩሲያ በካይሮ እና በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ጥረት እንደምታደርግ የገለጸች ሲሆን አሜሪካ በበኩሏ በኢራን የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች።
oromo: Humnoonni galaana Iran kan IRGC yeroo ammaa qarqara galaana Hormuz to'achaa jiraachuu ibsaniiru, akkasumas dooniin waraana Amerikaa USS Abraham Lincoln erga waggaa tokkoof deemsa waraanaa erga raawwatee booda gara buufata isaa deebi'eera. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Gaza itti fufee lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa jira. Prezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Putin nagaa buusuuf gumaacha akka godhan waadaa seenan, yeroo kanatti immoo Ameerikaan dooniiwwan boba'aa Iran irratti kaffaltii fi adabbii haaraa dabsiteetti.

title: October 7th never ended for Gaza, Palestinian journalist says
english: Journalist Mahmoud Mushtaha argues that the events following October 7th are still ongoing in Gaza rather than being a past anniversary. He reports that the humanitarian situation continues to deteriorate due to persistent military strikes, land occupation, and severe restrictions on essential aid. Because of these unrelenting conditions, he emphasizes that the residents have no opportunity to find closure or move forward.
amharic: ጋዜጠኛ ማህሙድ ሙሽታሃ ጥቅምት 7 ቀን የተከሰተው ክስተት ያለፈ ታሪክ ሳይሆን አሁንም በጋዛ እየቀጠለ ያለ ቀውስ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል። ቀጣይነት ባለው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት፣ የምድር ወረራ እና ለዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ዕርዳታዎች መከልከል ምክንያት የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች ሁኔታ እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን አስረድቷል። በእነዚህ አስከፊ ሁኔታዎች ምክንያት የጋዛ ህዝብ ከጦርነቱ መዘዝ ለመላቀቅ እና ወደ መደበኛ ህይወት ለመመለስ ምንም አይነት እድል እንደሌለው ተናግሯል።
oromo: Gaazexeessaan Mahaamud Mushtahaa akka jedhutti, mudannoon Onkololeessa 7 badii darbee kan yaadatamu osoo hin taane, har'as gaazaa keessatti itti fufee kan jiru balaadha. Sababa weerara waraanaa, lafa humnaan qabachuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa dhowwachuun haalli jireenyaa jiraattotaa guyyaa guyyaan hammaachaa akka jiru ibseera. Sababa rakkoolee cimaa kanaatiin, namoonni achi jiraatan jireenya isaanii gara duriitti deebisuuf carraa akka hin qabne ibsameera.

title: Iranian lawmaker says Tehran not seeking production of nuclear weapons
english: Iranian official Alaeddin Boroujerdi has denied that Tehran is pursuing nuclear weapons, emphasizing that their program follows international treaties. This statement responds to US Vice President JD Vance, who recently urged Iran to significantly lower its uranium enrichment levels as a condition for diplomatic progress. While Iran maintains its activities are peaceful, the US continues to demand verifiable actions rather than just verbal assurances regarding their nuclear program.
amharic: የኢራኑ ህግ አውጪ አላዲን ቦሩጄርዲ፣ ቴህራን የኑክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ ለመስራት እንደማትፈልግ በመግለጽ የሀገሪቱ የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ከአለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶች ጋር የሚጣጣም መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ኢራን የኑክሌር ማበልጸጊያ አቅሟን እንድትቀንስ መጠየቃቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ኢራን ስራዋ ሰላማዊ እንደሆነ ስትገልጽ፣ አሜሪካ ግን በአባባል ብቻ ሳይሆን በተግባር የሚታይ ለውጥ እንደምትፈልግ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, biyyattii meeshaa niwukileraa oomishuuf karoora hin qabdu; akkasumas sagantaan isaanii kan bu'uureffate waliigaltee idil-addunyaa irratti akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kennamee erga itti aanaa pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, Iran karoora ishee kana akka hir'iftu gaafatanii booda. Iran hojiin ishee nageenyaaf akka ta'e kan ibsitu yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan garuu jecha qofa osoo hin taane tarkaanfii qabatamaa akka barbaaddu ibsiteetti.

title: Pakistani premier condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
english: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has publicly denounced recent Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, which caused civilian casualties at major airports. Sharif reaffirmed Pakistan’s firm support for the kingdom’s security and sovereignty, citing their mutual defense agreements. He demanded an immediate end to the violence and praised Saudi forces for their efforts to intercept incoming missiles.
amharic: የፓኪስታኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼህባዝ ሻሪፍ በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ባለው የመከላከያ ስምምነት መሰረት የሳውዲን ሉዓላዊነትና ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ፓኪስታን ከጎናቸው እንደምትቆም አረጋግጠዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃታቸውን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ የጠየቁት ሻሪፍ፣ የሳውዲ የጸጥታ ሃይሎች ሚሳኤሎችን በመከልከል ያሳዩትን ብቃት አድንቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Paakistaan Shehbaaz Shaariif haleellaa gareen Huutii buufataalee xiyyaaraa Saudii Arabaa irratti raawwate cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Shaariif akka jedhanitti, Paakistaan waliigaltee ittisaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiruun walqabatee, nageenyaa fi kabajamuu daangaa Saudii Arabaaf gargaarsa guutuu kennitu. Haleellaa kana akka hatattamaan dhaaban garee Huutiif akeekkachiisa dabarsuun, waraanni Saudii haleellaa kana ittisuuf carraaqqii godhe dinqisiifataniiru.

title: Over 200 organisations set to join 'Global Day of Action' for Palestine
english: More than 200 international organizations are planning a coordinated day of protest this Saturday to support Palestine. Groups from 60 countries, including labor unions and student networks, aim to move beyond traditional demonstrations by using civil intervention to challenge complicity in the conflict. The organizers are calling for systemic accountability regarding Israel's actions in Gaza.
amharic: ከ200 የሚበልጡ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ለፍልስጤም ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመግለጽ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በተቀናጀ መልኩ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ለማድረግ ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል። ከ60 በላይ አገራት የተውጣጡ የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ፣ የሠራተኛ ማህበራት እና የተማሪዎች ቡድኖች በዚህ እንቅስቃሴ ይሳተፋሉ። አዘጋጆቹ ድርጊታቸው ከወትሮው የተለየ እና በጋዛ ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት ተጠያቂነትን የሚጠይቅ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa 200 ol ta'an, Roobii darbe akka beeksisanitti, guyyaa Sanbataa kana deeggarsa Filisxeemii ibsuuf hiriira waloo ta'e gaggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Biyyoota 60 keessaa gareen hawaasaa, gamtaan hojjettootaa fi barattoonni hiriira kana irratti kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaanii tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuun yakka waraanaa fi ajjeechaa sanyii irratti gaaffii itti gaafatamummaa kaasuudha.

title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
english: A former Ukrainian security officer, Vitalii Zhykovych, has spoken to the BBC from prison regarding his alleged involvement in a June bomb attack in Monaco against a wealthy businessman. Zhykovych claims the operation was orchestrated by senior members of Ukraine's military intelligence agency, HUR, and disputes accusations that he murdered the woman who planted the bomb. While the primary suspect in the explosion, Anastasia Berezovska, was later found dead, Zhykovych insists he did not order the attack and points to an intelligence officer named Vladyslav Reut as the person who authorized the mission.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዩክሬን የደህንነት መኮንን ቪታሊ ዚኮቪች በሞናኮ ውስጥ ባለሀብት ላይ የተፈጸመውን የቦምብ ጥቃት በተመለከተ ከእስር ቤት ሆኖ ለቢቢሲ መግለጫ ሰጥቷል። ዚኮቪች ጥቃቱ የታቀደው በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ መረጃ ኤጀንሲ (HUR) ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት እንደሆነና ቦምቡን የጣለችውን ሴት በመግደል የተከሰሰውን ክስ እንደማይቀበል ተናግሯል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው አናስታሲያ ቤሬዞቭስካ ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ሞታ የተገኘች ሲሆን፣ ዚኮቪች ራሱ ጥቃቱን እንዳላዘዘ እና ለኦፕሬሽኑ ዋና ተጠያቂው የደህንነት መኮንኑ ቭላዲላቭ ሬውት መሆኑን አስረድቷል።
oromo: Ajajaa nageenyaa duraanii kan Yukreen Vitalii Zhykovich, ji'a Waxabajjii darbe Monakootti nama dureessa tokko irratti haleellaa boombii gaggeeffame irratti hirmaachuun isaa himamee, mana hidhaa taa'ee BBC'f ibsa kenneera. Zhykovich haleellaan kun kan qindeeffame qaamolee olaanoo raayyaa ittisa biyyattii (HUR) irraa akka ta'ee fi dubartii boombichaa dhaabde ajjeese jedhamee himannaa dhihaateef akka hin fudhanne ibseera. Dubartiin boombicha dhaabde jedhamtu Anastasia Berezovska yeroo gabaabaa booda duutee kan argamte yoo ta'u, Zhykovich haleellicha akka hin ajajnee fi itti gaafatamaan inni guddaan qondaala nageenyaa Vladyslav Reut akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
english: The U.S. Pentagon has announced that the execution of Nidal Hasan, responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, will be broadcast via livestream. This event marks the first military execution by firing squad in over 60 years, with officials stating it is intended to demonstrate the severe consequences of such crimes. The execution is scheduled to take place on December 3 in Texas.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር በ2009 በፎርት ሁድ የጦር ሰፈር ጥቃት የፈጸመውን ኒዳል ሀሰንን በጥይት የመቅጣት ሂደት በቀጥታ ስርጭት እንደሚተላለፍ አስታውቋል። ይህ ከ60 ዓመታት በላይ በወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት የሚከናወን የመጀመሪያው የግድያ ቅጣት ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ ለከባድ ወንጀሎች የሚወሰደውን ቅጣት ለማሳየት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ግድያው ታህሳስ 3 ቀን በቴክሳስ ግዛት ይፈጸማል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa, nama bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Fort Hood irratti ajjeechaa raawwate Nidal Hasan, adabbiin du'aa isaa dhukaasaan raawwatamu karaa viidiyoo qajeelaa (livestream) akka darbu beeksiseera. Kun waggaa 60 oliif waraana keessatti adabbiin du'aa akkanaa yommuu raawwatamu yeroo jalqabaati; hoogganoonnis tarkiinichi yakka akkanaa irratti adabbiin cimaan akka jiru agarsiisuuf akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Adabbiin kun Muddee 3, Texas keessatti akka raawwatamuuf karoorfameera.

title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
english: Adidas has initiated legal action against the Australian fashion brand White Fox for allegedly copying its iconic three-stripe trademark. The sportswear giant claims that White Fox's use of a four-stripe design is confusingly similar and falsely suggests a partnership between the two companies. Adidas is now seeking financial damages and a permanent stop to the sale of the disputed clothing items.
amharic: አዲዳስ ታዋቂውን የሶስት መስመር ምልክቱን በመቅዳት የአውስትራሊያውን የፋሽን ኩባንያ ዋይት ፎክስ ክስ መስርቶበታል። የስፖርት ልብስ አምራቹ ኩባንያ ዋይት ፎክስ የሚጠቀምበት የአራት መስመር ዲዛይን የደንበኞችን አእምሮ ግራ የሚያጋባ እና በሁለቱ ኩባንያዎች መካከል ግንኙነት እንዳለ የሚያሳይ ነው ሲል ይከራከራል። አዲዳስ ከዚህ ውዝግብ ጋር በተያያዘ የገንዘብ ካሳ እንዲከፈለውና የተከራካሪው ኩባንያ ምርቶቹን ለገበያ ማቅረቡ እንዲቆም ጠይቋል።

title: USS Abraham Lincoln returns after record-breaking deployment
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has officially returned to San Diego following a challenging mission that lasted over 300 days. While families celebrated the homecoming, the extended deployment resulted in significant difficulties, including equipment failures, supply issues, and reports of mental health crises among the crew. The vessel had been deployed to support American military operations involving Iran.

oromo: Dooniin waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamtu, duula guyyoota 300 ol fudhate booda gara San Diego deebiteetti. title: UN extends Darfur arms embargo, blocks broader Sudan sanctions proposal
english: The United Nations Security Council has decided to extend the existing arms embargo on Sudan's Darfur region for two months. While the United States pushed to expand these restrictions across the entire country, the proposal was blocked by Russia and China. Consequently, the current measures will remain limited to Darfur while diplomatic discussions continue.
